title: Remove Swiping
text:
⭐⭐ Very Disappointing Payment Experience – HDFC Bank!

Extremely frustrated with HDFC Bank’s swipe-to-pay option! 😡

Have you ever thought about customers whose phone display is damaged or whose touchscreen is not working properly? How are they supposed to complete a payment when the app forces them to swipe?

My phone’s touchscreen has a display issue, and the centre portion is not working. Because of this, I am unable to swipe and complete my payment. This is incredibly frustrating, especially when you urgently need to make a payment.

A banking app should be designed for ALL customers, not only those with perfectly working touchscreens. Why force customers to swipe when there could be alternative options such as a simple “Pay” button, tap-to-confirm, or PIN-based confirmation?

HDFC Bank, please understand that not everyone has a fully functional phone display. Customers should not be stuck or prevented from making payments just because one part of their touchscreen isn’t working.

🚨 Please remove the compulsory swipe option and introduce an alternative payment confirmation method. Make the app more accessible, user-friendly, and practical for everyone.

Very disappointed with this experience. I hope HDFC Bank takes this feedback seriously and makes the necessary changes instead of forcing customers to struggle with a simple payment.

#HDFCBank #CustomerFeedback #DigitalBanking #Accessibility #PaymentIssues
